items.period: Shang dynasty oracle-script style; Commons page cites source form 甲903 合34165 but does not provide a specific date for that item
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script; modern vector redraw, not an artifact photograph
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of Shang oracle-script 水. CUHK describes the early graph as a flowing current with side marks for droplets.
items.alt: Vector glyph representing 水 in Shang oracle-bone script style.
items.selection_reason: Shows the earliest described graphic structure, the flowing line and side droplets, with a Commons source page that identifies the character and reuse status.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public-domain dedication as stated on the exact Commons file page; its source note attributes the form to the Sinica database.

items.period: Early Western Zhou, according to the Commons description’s source note for 沈子它簋蓋
items.tradition: Western Zhou bronze inscription style; modern vector redraw, not a photograph of the bronze vessel
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 水 in a Western Zhou bronze-inscription style; the file page associates this form with the cover of the 沈子它簋.
items.alt: Vector glyph representing 水 in Western Zhou bronze script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a comparison point for the database’s account that bronze forms retain the flowing-water picture; the source page names an early Western Zhou bronze source.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated for the vector representation on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: The images are modern vector representations of historical script styles, not photographs of original inscriptions. The Commons reader gave the source references, but this research did not inspect the underlying artifacts or the SVG pixels.
The Xiaoxuetang query page for 水 did not open successfully, so no image from its database is proposed.
